sources.entry: Qwen - Pretrained large language model proposed by Alibaba Cloud. #free

summary.one_liner: QwenLM/Qwen is the official repository for the Qwen series of open-weight bilingual (Chinese and English) large language models from Alibaba Cloud, covering base and chat variants from 1.8B to 72B parameters.
summary.what_it_does: The repository publishes the Qwen base language models (Qwen-1.8B, 7B, 14B, 72B) and chat-tuned variants (Qwen-Chat), with Int4 and Int8 quantized versions for some sizes. The README covers quickstart inference with Hugging Face Transformers and ModelScope, batch inference, and CPU and multi-GPU loading. It also documents GPTQ quantization and KV cache quantization with memory and speed measurements. Finetuning instructions cover full-parameter tuning, LoRA, and Q-LoRA, with memory tables by sequence length. Deployment options include vLLM with FastChat, a Gradio-style web UI, a CLI demo, an OpenAI-style API server, and Docker images. The README also describes tool use, ReAct-style function calling, a code interpreter benchmark, long-context extension techniques, and access through Alibaba Cloud's DashScope API. The README notes that this repo is no longer actively maintained in favor of QwenLM/Qwen2.
use_cases: run a Chinese and English chatbot locally
finetune an LLM on custom data with LoRA or Q-LoRA
deploy an OpenAI-compatible API for a self-hosted model
quantize a model to Int4 or Int8 to reduce GPU memory
build a web or CLI chat demo
build tool-using agents or function calling apps
serve a model with vLLM for fast inference
how_to_run: Load "Qwen/Qwen-7B-Chat" with transformers AutoModelForCausalLM and AutoTokenizer (trust_remote_code=True)
notable: Full family from 1.8B to 72B parameters, with base and chat variants and Int4/Int8 quantized checkpoints
Pretrained on up to 3 trillion tokens with a focus on Chinese and English
Documented memory and speed profiles for BF16, Int8, and Int4 inference, plus finetuning memory tables
Long-context support up to 32K tokens using NTK-aware interpolation, window attention, and LogN scaling
Tool-use and code-interpreter benchmarks reported in the README
caveats: The README states this repo is no longer actively maintained; the author points users to QwenLM/Qwen2.
Qwen-14B-Chat and Qwen-7B-Chat cannot use KV cache quantization together with flash attention at the same time.
The README says CPU inference is likely to be extremely slow, and recommends qwen.cpp for CPU deployment.
Larger models need substantial GPU memory; for example, 72B full BF16 inference is listed at 144.69GB across 2xA100.
